title: Criterion A: Listening — The School Eco-Invention
scenario: Listen to an interview with Mia, a 6th grade student who invented a solar-powered bird feeder for the school garden.
prompt: Listen carefully to the audio interview. What was Mia's main inspiration, and how does the feeder protect the seeds from rain?
rubricJson: {"1-2": "Identifies basic stated facts", "3-4": "Identifies main ideas and some supporting details", "5-6": "Demonstrates clear understanding of explicit and implicit messages", "7-8": "Perceptively analyses conventions, purpose and perspective"}
sampleAnswer: Mia was inspired by observing birds during winter biology class. The feeder has a tilted roof made of recycled plastic that automatically shades the food tray.

title: Criterion B: Reading — Zero-Waste School Cafeteria
scenario: Read an article from an international youth magazine about how students in Stockholm eliminated plastic waste in their school cafeteria.
prompt: Read the article. How did students convince the school administration to change policies? Explain using two examples from the text.
rubricJson: {"1-2": "Understands few basic words and ideas", "3-4": "Understands main idea and simple details", "5-6": "Understands nuances, organization and connections", "7-8": "Effectively evaluates purpose, audience and tone"}
sampleAnswer: Students created an interactive waste audit presentation and calculated that the school could save budget money by switching to washable trays.

title: Criterion C: Speaking — My Favorite Hobby & Club
scenario: You are presenting your after-school activity to exchange students visiting your school.
prompt: Describe what you do in your club, why you enjoy it, and give one reason why newcomers should join. Use phrases: 'In my experience...', 'I really enjoy...', 'What makes it special is...'
rubricJson: {"1-2": "Uses limited vocabulary, frequent pauses", "3-4": "Communicates simply with reasonable pronunciation", "5-6": "Communicates clearly with good flow and varied vocabulary", "7-8": "Speaks fluently, expressively, and engages the audience naturally"}
sampleAnswer: In my experience, joining the Drama Club helped me make great friends. I really enjoy acting because it builds confidence. You should join because we laugh a lot and perform exciting plays!

title: Criterion D: Writing — Letter to an International Pen Pal
scenario: Write an informal email (60-80 words) to Alex, your pen pal from London, telling him about your favorite traditional holiday in your country.
prompt: Include: 1) What the holiday is called; 2) How your family celebrates; 3) What special food you eat. Start with 'Dear Alex,' and end with 'Best wishes, [Your Name]'.
rubricJson: {"1-2": "Writes basic phrases with frequent grammatical errors", "3-4": "Writes simple coherent sentences with understandable meaning", "5-6": "Writes structured text using appropriate vocabulary and connectors", "7-8": "Writes rich, accurate, engaging text tailored to the format"}
sampleAnswer: Dear Alex, I'm writing to tell you about Maslenitsa! It is a fun spring festival. My family makes delicious golden pancakes with honey and berries. We also play outdoor games and say goodbye to the cold winter. Do you have a similar festival in the UK? Best wishes, Anna.
